ECO, cortometraje de Jose Adrianzen. Thr: ECO, a short film by Jose Adrianzen. A psychological thriller set in the eighties. Peru, 2023, 13 minutes, shot in 6K. Not yet released.
César, un psiquiatra respetable, esconde: César, a respected psychiatrist, hides a double life behind his practice and his marriage. When Victoria, his young patient and lover, finds the courage to tell the truth, the fragile balance of his world breaks. Among mirrors, secrets and suspicion, the wife everyone believes is fragile turns out to be the most lucid of all.

Jose Adrianzen, dueño de esta web. Los d: Jose Adrianzen, owner of this site. The data is stored on the site's own server, hosted by Hostinger. It is not sold or shared with anyone.
Qué páginas abres, cuánto rato las tiene: Which pages you open, how long they stay on screen, how far you scroll, which sections and photos you see, which links you click and what you do with the documentary (play, pause, skip, finish). Also the type of device, system, browser, language, time zone, screen size and the site you came from.
Se usa un instante para saber el país, l: It is used for an instant to look up the country, region, city and internet provider, with DB-IP's free database. Then it is discarded: it is not stored.
Tu navegador guarda un código al azar y: Your browser keeps a random code and the site recognizes you when you return. It does not know your name.
La visita se cuenta igual, pero con un c: The visit is still counted, but with a code that changes every day. Today's visit cannot be linked to tomorrow's.
No hay Google Analytics, ni píxeles de r: There is no Google Analytics, no social media pixels and no advertising cookies. The documentary plays through Vimeo, which receives the video connection with its do not track option turned on.
Puedes pedir ver, corregir o borrar tus: You can ask to see, correct or delete your data, or change your answer, by writing to yo@joseadrianzen.com. This measurement follows Peru's personal data protection law, Ley 29733.

Jose Adrianzen, director y productor de: Jose Adrianzen, Peruvian film director and producer. He trained at EPIC and directed the award winning documentary Between Dust and Dreams and the short ECO.
Siempre he creído que las personas valen: I have always believed that people matter a great deal and that, if necessary, you have to reach the farthest corner to make them visible.

En Arequipa, María Reyes es pallaquera,: In Arequipa, María Reyes is a pallaquera, sifting for ore in the rock others have already discarded. In Puno, Julia Pomalique faces the barriers of a culture that cannot picture a woman in the mine. In Madre de Dios, Vilma Contreras defied the stereotypes and is still standing.
Entre polvo y sueños acompaña a tres min: Between Dust and Dreams follows three women in Peru’s artisanal and small scale mining, an issue now on the public agenda that rarely listens to them. Three years of shooting in tunnels and on the plains so their voice can travel far.
Desde pequeño, el cine y la política fue: Since I was a child, film and politics were my two great passions. At first I wanted to be president, so I studied law to understand the laws and how the State works. Life took me somewhere else. In film I found a more powerful way to make an impact and to tell the stories that deserve to be heard.
La curiosidad me ha llevado a recorrer c: Curiosity has taken me across almost all of Peru, much of South America and different corners of the world. Those journeys taught me to look at realities very different from mine and confirmed one thing, film is a tool for social change.
Tengo estudios en cine y en actuación. Q: I trained in filmmaking and acting. I also wanted to contribute to the industry from the management side (production, financing and distribution), so I am studying business engineering. In recent years I have worked with several NGOs, telling stories that tend to be forgotten.
Terminé de rodar el cortometraje ECO, ho: I finished shooting the short film ECO, now on the festival circuit. But the project that has defined my path is Between Dust and Dreams, three years of my life to give a voice to Peru’s women miners and stand up for their struggle.
